notes.title: NEW GAME COMING OUT
notes.content:
I have a new, much better, game coming out called Ravager. You can check out some early screenshots of the game here:

http://www.indiedb.com/games/ravager

notes.title: CONTRACT GAME
notes.content:
S Houben's game, CONTRACT, has just released and is on sale. Be sure to check it out. 

It is an amazing new game, co-developed by me, where you must shoot, hack and massacre your way past armed guards, security systems and other challenges in order to reach your targets. You play as a man, blackmailed into the art of assassination by the kidnappers of his brother.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/409170/

notes.title: MAJOR BUG FIX
notes.content: A lot of customers have been complaining about a couple of bugs and I have made sure to remove and patch and known bugs so that people can enjoy the game. MULTIPLE BUGS HAVE BEEN PATCHED! I pay lot's of attention to the user reviews and discussions so be sure to leave one.

notes.title: FIXED SAVE SYSTEM AND CLOUD SAVES
notes.content:
The games save system has now been updated so you can save your progress every level or whenever you press esc. 

Cloud saves now work so you can load your save files on all computers.
